elena_billing: Heads-up  acquirer just flagged INV-113900 for a 'goods_not_received' dispute from MerchantData Co. Amount $9,750. They say no API credits were delivered. Need evidence packet.

billing-bot: Alert: DISPUTE_OPEN id=dp_Jk3n amount=9750.00 currency=USD reason=goods_not_received open_ts=1967205500

mike_support: Ticket #7334 shows merchant emailed claiming they never got the CSV export feature they paid for. Support chat shows delivery link and confirmation on 2026-03-26. I can attach the transcript and the delivery link headers.

ravi_fraud: Quick triage: Gateway shows capture, AVS=Y, CVV matched. IP during delivery matches merchant office range. Usage metering shows export API called 3x on 03/25-03/26 from merchant's API key. Recommend include: invoice, capture receipt, delivery webhook receipts, API call logs, and support transcript.

cara_ops: I've uploaded delivery receipts and export job logs: s3://redwood-disputes/INV-113900/export_jobs_20260325-26.log and webhooks/export_delivery_113900.json

elena_billing: Core txn snippet for packet:
```
Invoice: INV-113900
Customer: MerchantData Co (acct md-3009)
Amount: $9,750.00
Charge ID: ch_Lp4qT
Auth code: 991023
Dispute reason: goods_not_received
```

zoe_legal: We'll need proof of delivery (webhook headers, timestamps), support transcript with consent to delivery, and confirmation email headers. Ensure PII redacted. If merchant signed SLA terms, include signed agreement.

mike_support: Pasting redacted excerpt: > customer: "I can't find the CSV export I paid for" > agent: "We delivered the export to your account and emailed a link on 2026-03-25 17:02:13 UTC"

ravi_fraud: Drafting rebuttal narrative: exported data delivered via authenticated webhook and accessible from their account; API logs show successful job completion. Will attach risk flags if any.

elena_billing: Uploading packet to disputes dashboard now: https://console.redwood.inference/disputes/INV-113900  tagging @zoe_legal and @ravi_fraud. ETA 1h.

billing-bot: Reminder: goods_not_received evidence window = 7 days. Current time left ~6d 23h.

zoe_legal: Reviewing after upload. If acquirer wants, we'll provide signed agent declaration and chain-of-custody for logs.

elena_billing: Evidence uploaded and submitted. Please confirm redactions.

mike_support: Redactions complete. Monitoring acquirer response.

ravi_fraud: Added gateway decision screenshot and API job run logs. Leaving note on disputes dashboard.

zoe_legal: Packet looks complete. Submitting.

elena_billing: Submitted to acquirer. Will update when outcome available. :white_check_mark:
